title: Turkish Thai Eggplant Cig Kofte
description: A garlicky and comforting Turkish dish featuring Thai eggplant, made dairy-free friendly, and formed into cig kofte.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Cut the Thai eggplant into small pieces and blanch them in boiling water for 5 minutes.
Drain the eggplant and set it aside to cool.
In a large pan, heat the vegetable oil over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Stir in the tomato paste, paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Add the cooled eggplant to the pan and stir to combine.
Transfer the mixture to a bowl and stir in the breadcrumbs.
Use your hands to shape the mixture into small cig kofte.
Place the cig kofte on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and bake for 20 minutes.
